sources.covers: ring breathing 717 and 894 cm-1 (uncoordinated EC; 632 nm), shoulder ~704

notes: EC is solid at RT (mp ~34-37 °C). Positions here are from liquid EC (melt) or EC in carbonate electrolytes, not the crystal; crystalline EC differs, especially in the C=O region. Sources disagree by ±3 cm-1 (893-897 for ring breathing; 1773-1781/1800-1808 for the C=O doublet). Diagnostic: 893 (free) vs 903 (Li+-bound) ring breathing and 717-720 vs 729-733 ring deformation. No intensities given in the sources; ring breathing ~893 is the strongest band in the fingerprint region. C-H stretch positions are from SERS and may be slightly shifted from normal Raman. Allen 2014 (632 nm): uncoordinated EC ring bands at 717 and 894 cm-1 (shoulder ~704); they shift to 729 and 905 cm-1 on Li+ coordination.

Allen 2014 (632 nm, (EC)n-LiX) gives 729 and 905 cm-1 for Li+-coordinated EC (vs 717/894 uncoordinated).
